one_line: Early Gurjara-Pratihara king whose ambitions carried Rājasthān power toward Kannauj before a clash with the Rashtrakuta Dhruva.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, tall and athletic with a commander’s bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, strong jawline, wheatish North Indian complexion, neatly trimmed full moustache, short close beard along the jaw, and sharp dark eyes; default expression is calm, alert confidence with a hint of stern resolve.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a high topknot (kunḍala-style) at the crown, sides smoothed back, no loose fringe; a plain narrow gold circlet rests low on the forehead with a small central red cabochon gem.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length cotton tunic (angarkha-style) in deep brick red with wrap-over front tied at the right side by narrow cords, bordered with a narrow gold weave at cuffs and hem; over this is a fitted sleeveless mail-and-plate cuirass in dull iron-grey with small rectangular brass edging at shoulders, extending just below the chest; his lower garment is a tightly wrapped warrior’s dhoti in muted cream, pleated in front and drawn to mid-calf, with a narrow dark green border, worn over simple brown leather sandals; a broad dark green cloth sash (patka) with subtle woven geometric patterns in gold is tied at the waist, one end hanging to the left thigh; over his left shoulder is a diagonally draped, medium-weight shawl in muted indigo, plain except for a thin red stripe near its border, leaving both hands free; jewellery is restrained—small gold hoop earrings, a single medium-width gold bangle on his right wrist, and a simple amulet pendant on a cord tucked just inside the tunic neckline.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved, single-edged iron sword of early talwar form with a simple crossguard and disc pommel, carried in a plain dark brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings, worn suspended from a belt on his left hip so the hilt angles forward for a right-hand draw.

ref_desc: Vatsaraja Pratihara is a tall, wheat-complexioned warrior-king with an oval face, moustache and short beard, black hair in a high topknot with a gold circlet, wearing a brick-red angarkha, iron-grey cuirass, cream dhoti, dark green sash, indigo shawl and brown sandals, carrying a simple curved iron sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style historical character model of Vatsaraja Pratihara: a tall, athletic North Indian king in his late thirties with an oval face, wheatish complexion, sharp dark eyes, a neatly trimmed full moustache and short beard along the jaw, and thick black hair gathered into a high topknot with the sides smoothed back. A plain narrow gold circlet with a small red gem rests low on his forehead. He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length brick-red cotton angarkha that wraps and ties at the right side, edged with a fine gold border at cuffs and hem, over which sits a fitted sleeveless iron-grey mail-and-plate cuirass with subtle brass edging at the shoulders. His lower garment is a tightly wrapped cream dhoti with a narrow dark green border, pleated in front and reaching mid-calf, paired with simple brown leather sandals. A broad dark green patterned sash is tied at his waist, one end hanging over his left thigh, and a muted indigo shawl with a thin red stripe is draped diagonally from his right shoulder across his torso and around his back, leaving his arms free. Show minimal jewellery: small gold hoop earrings, a single gold bangle on his right wrist, and a barely visible amulet cord at his neck. At his left hip, suspended from a belt, is his signature weapon: a slightly curved, single-edged iron sword of early talwar form in a plain dark brown leather scabbard with modest brass fittings, its hilt angled forward for a quick right-hand draw. Use a restrained palette of brick red, muted cream, dark green, indigo, iron grey and brown, and present him from multiple angles with clear views of face, hair, armour, garments and sword for consistent redrawing.
